items.title: Dominic James "Nick" La Rocca Interview, 1958-06-09
items.q: Holly Expus, your friend J.C. Avoté, and he signs it Jean C. Avoté.

ctx.x: june 3rd 1916 those are the correct dates after i looked up my books the others was given from memory and that will show you about anybody that gives from memory can remember all the things that's happened in the exact dates and times of what has transpired after 40 years this man mr abety is trying to clear up a mystery in jazz which he thinks is a mystery some of his people has been right on it that i had given him these dates when he first asked me about the dates i worked all day long come home i'm tired i…

with this thing here i didn't i didn't quite finish the only you didn't and excuse me for interrupting the labby cafe four weeks june the 5th till july 6 1916 casino gardens from july 6 to december 27th somewhere around 27th or 28 1916. these are very slight differences but they have their importance new paragraph i'm afraid now to be obliged to leave you as you can see i have broken in writing you the e of my machine e is in quotation marks and it is impossible to type correctly now

I'll write you again soon. I wish to you and your family a very good Happy New Year. And Holly Expus, your friend J.C. Avoté, and he signs it Jean C. Avoté. P.S. You will find in this letter the results of my investigations in the New York newspapers between 1915 and 1919. What he means about his typewriter is that he wrote the E key and he has to put acute marks and grave marks on his E's. It's the only way he can finish a letter.
